mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining unemployment rate signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 6.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,400,000 annual units signal robust consumer demand and economic expansion, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.5 (index 2017=100) indicates sustained manufacturing growth and rising corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in federal funds rate and consumer inflation signal accommodative policy and stable price environment, jointly driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL decline fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts and retail sales signal robust consumer demand, jointly boosting corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor markets (UNRATE < 5.0%), inflationary pressures trigger rate hikes that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
